parole.significato: Denotes the conditional mood in sentences within a conditional sub-clause; if.
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish ـسه (-sa, -se), from Old Turkic *-sar, from Proto-Turkic *-sar or *-sa, where the "r" was gradually omitted over time. Cognate with Old Uyghur *-sar.

parole.significato: A title of imperial rank in Turkic and Mongolic languages, ruler of a khaganate; khagan.
parole.testo: Inherited from late Ottoman Turkish قاغان (kağan), ultimately from Old Turkic 𐰴𐰍𐰣 (k¹g¹n¹ /⁠qaġan, xaġan⁠/), from Proto-Turkic *kagan. Cognates with Mongolian ᠬᠠᠭᠠᠨ (qaɣan), Kazakh қаған (qağan), Kyrgyz каган (kagan), Southern Altai каан (kaan), Tatar каган (qağan), Uyghur قاغان (qaghan), Uzbek xoqo
Inherited from Ottoman Turkish كیر (kir), from Old Turkic kir, from Proto-Turkic *kir (“dirt”).
From Ottoman Turkish كرپك (kirpik), from Old Turkic kirpik, from Proto-Turkic *kirpik (“eyelash”). See more at Azerbaijani kirpik.
